row.title: The main rule exempted an app that no longer writes to main (APP-DRIFT-1)
row.body: The ruleset on main named app 5806148 as its only bypass actor; the tick Worker writes with a newer app, so GitHub answered 422 to every workflow data commit and runway, credential and backup readings never reached main. The resolver in seed/worker/src/auth/rulesets.js now re-applies the rule whenever the applied row does not name the app in use. Data pull requests are capped at three open (DATA-PR-CAP-1) after the refusal produced 14 in ten minutes.
